title: It depends: Incorporating correlations for joint aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties of high-dimensional output spaces
abstract: arXiv:2608.24518v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) plays a vital role in enhancing the reliability of deep learning model predictions, especially in scenarios with high-dimensional output spaces. This paper addresses the dual nature of uncertainty -- aleatoric and epistemic -- focusing on their joint integration in high-dimensional regression tasks. For example, in applications like medical image segmentation or restoration, aleatoric uncertainty captures inherent data noise, while epistemic uncertainty quantifies the model's confidence in unfamiliar conditions. Modeling both jointly enables more reliable predictions by reflecting both unavoidable variability and knowledge gaps, whereas modeling only one limits transparency and robustness. translated_title: 视情况而定：结合高维输出空间中偶然不确定性与认知不确定性的相关性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24518v1 公告类型：新 摘要：不确定性量化（UQ）在增强深度学习模型预测可靠性方面发挥着至关重要的作用，尤其是在高维输出空间场景中。本文探讨了不确定性的双重性质——偶然不确定性和认知不确定性——重点关注它们在 高维回归任务中的联合集成。例如，在医学图像分割或恢复等应用中，偶然不确定性捕捉固有的数据噪声，而认知不确定性量化模型在陌生条件下的置信度。联合建模两者可以通过反映不可避免的变异性和知识差距来实现更可靠的预测，而仅建模其中之一则会限制透明度和鲁棒性。我们提出了一种新方法，使用低秩加对角协方差结构来近似所得的联合不确定性，捕捉关键的输出相关性，同时避免全协方差的计算负担。
tldr: 本文提出一种新方法，通过低秩加对角协方差结构联合建模高维回归中的偶然和认知不确定性，有效捕捉输出相关性并降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel method that jointly models aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties in high-dimensional regression using a low-rank plus diagonal covariance structure, effectively capturing output correlations while reducing computational costs.
